review.orientation: This PR implements PR-4 by introducing the Fees module (IFeeCalculator/FeeCalculator), adding the GET api/payments/quote endpoint, and integrating fee calculation and FeeIncome ledger posting into PaymentService. It aims to provide pre-payment fee and exchange rate quotes and charge the applicable cross-currency fee from the payer upon payment execution.

findings.title: PaymentService.QuoteAsync returns unrounded CreditedAmount
findings.claim: The requirement specifies that Quote/QuoteAsync must return a rounded CreditedAmount. In QuoteAsync, cross-currency creditedAmount is assigned the raw output of _fx.Convert without rounding to 2 decimal places using MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero.
findings.requirement_link: PaymentQuote(decimal Amount, string Currency, decimal Fee, decimal CreditedAmount, string CreditedCurrency, decimal Rate) is added to Bank.Modules.Payments.Application, and IPaymentService exposes Quote / QuoteAsync(Guid fromAccountId, Guid toAccountId, decimal amount) returning the fee, FX rate (1m for same-currency), and rounded CreditedAmount without modifying balances or persisting a Payment.
findings.suggested_fix: Round the converted amount to two decimal places: var creditedAmount = sameCurrency ? amount : Math.Round(_fx.Convert(amount, fromAccount.Currency, toAccount.Currency), 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);

findings.title: Payer balance validation bypasses accounts where AllowOverdraft is true
findings.claim: PaymentService.PayAsync checks !fromAccount.AllowOverdraft before verifying balance < request.Amount + fee.Amount. If AllowOverdraft is true, the check is skipped, allowing payments when balance < amount + fee contrary to acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence:
if (!fromAccount.AllowOverdraft && fromAccount.Balance < request.Amount + fee.Amount)
                throw new InsufficientFundsException(request.FromAccountId);
findings.requirement_link: When executing a payment, PaymentService checks that the payer account balance is at least amount + fee before posting any ledger transfers; if balance < amount + fee, the payment fails with insufficient funds, no Payment is completed, and zero transfers are posted to either the recipient, FxClearing, or FeeIncome.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove !fromAccount.AllowOverdraft and check balance unconditionally: if (fromAccount.Balance < request.Amount + fee.Amount) throw new InsufficientFundsException(request.FromAccountId);

findings.title: Insufficient funds check covering amount plus fee and fee transfer posting are untested
findings.claim: PaymentService.PayAsync checks that balance >= amount + fee and posts a fee transfer to FeeIncome on cross-currency payments, but no tests verify that payments fail when balance covers amount but not amount + fee, or that FeeIncome is credited upon success.
findings.evidence:
if (!fromAccount.AllowOverdraft && fromAccount.Balance < request.Amount + fee.Amount)
                throw new InsufficientFundsException(request.FromAccountId);
findings.requirement_link: When executing a payment, PaymentService checks that the payer account balance is at least amount + fee before posting any ledger transfers; if balance < amount + fee, the payment fails with insufficient funds, no Payment is completed, and zero transfers are posted to either the recipient, FxClearing, or FeeIncome.
findings.suggested_fix: Add test cases in payment test suite verifying that a payment fails with InsufficientFundsException when balance < amount + fee, and that fee transfer to FeeIncome is executed when successful.

findings.title: FeeCalculator calculation and clamping logic has no test coverage
findings.claim: FeeTests only asserts on a manually created Fee record rather than invoking FeeCalculator.Quote. Core business rules—including 0.2% fee calculation, EUR 0.50 min and EUR 20.00 max FX conversion and clamping, rounding AwayFromZero, same-currency 0 fees, and non-positive amount rejection—are completely untested.
findings.requirement_link: IFeeCalculator.Quote(amount, fromCurrency, toCurrency) returns Fee(0m, fromCurrency) when fromCurrency equals toCurrency (case-insensitive).
findings.suggested_fix: Add unit tests exercising FeeCalculator.Quote with a mock or real IFxService to verify same-currency zero fee, cross-currency fee calculation, min/max clamping, rounding, and negative/zero amount validation.

findings.title: QuoteAsync and quote endpoint behavior are not tested
findings.claim: PaymentQuote_record_preserves_all_fields_and_value_equality tests only record constructor properties rather than IPaymentService.QuoteAsync or PaymentsController.Quote. findings.suggested_fix: Add unit and integration tests covering PaymentService.QuoteAsync and GET api/payments/quote for valid quotes, non-owner 403, and missing account 404 responses.
